Warrior.Title: Take the branch?
Warrior.Question: A sturdy tree branch. It will make you a Warrior, heavy damage but with thin defense. You can change your job later after level 20.

Defender.Title: Take the rolling pin?
Defender.Question: A heavy rolling pin. It will make you a Defender, built to take every hit. You can change your job later after level 20.

Enchanter.Title: Take the feather duster?
Enchanter.Question: A feather duster. It will make you an Enchanter, weaving magic spells against foes. You can change your job later after level 20.

Cleric.Title: Take the candlestick?
Cleric.Question: A candlestick. It will make you a Cleric, healer and reviver of the fallen. You can change your job later after level 20.

Human.Title: ...Drink?
Human.Question: Warm milk. It will make you a Human, strong and steady. You can change your race later after chapter 2.

Beastmen.Title: EAT?!
Beastmen.Question: A piece of raw meat. It will make you a Beastmen, an agile and dexterous race. You can change your race later after chapter 2.

Elf.Title: ...eat this?
Elf.Question: A shiny mushroom. It will make you an Elf, gifted in magic. You can change your race later after chapter 2.

FoodNarration.Human: Both hands on the bottle, this is mine! Nobody's even reaching for it, but I'm growling anyway.
FoodNarration.Beastmen: I didn't bite it, I pounced on it... There's meat chunks on the ceiling and the floor. Don't know how, but I'm going back for more.
FoodNarration.Elf: I ate the shiny mushroom in one bite. Now my tongue glows when I yawn! I keep yawning to check.

AwakeningText.Elf: A sparrow hopped onto my crib and stared, I stared back. I'm not losing to a bird on day one!
AwakeningText.Cat: I pushed a cup off the table on purpose, then the next one... Mother's shouting now, worth it!
AwakeningText.Fox: I swapped her honey cake for a rock and watched her look for it...
AwakeningText.HighElf: I sneezed and every candle went out... then they lit again on their own, so maybe I should learn to sneeze quieter.
AwakeningText.Human: I reach for everything and my hands don't listen yet... give it time, I'll get this body working.
AwakeningText.Wolf: I howled once, just to try it. Now every dog in the village is at the door. One even brought me a stick!
AwakeningText.CorruptedHuman: My shadow moved before I did. I waved, but it waved first... I'm choosing not to think about that.

RaceCutscene.PostAwakeningNotification: Mother's still out at the fences. Nobody here to tell me no... Well, time to find something to hit.
